items.problem: Migrated project does not build: CS0118 'ActivitySensor' is a namespace but is used like a type (Scenario3_ChangeEvents.xaml.cs:33), plus cascading XAML WMC9999. Every feature fails as a result.
items.evidence: migration-score.json winui_build='FAILED (CS0118 ... + XAML WMC9999)'; results.json metrics.builds=false, timeout=true; migrated source: App/MainWindow/MainPage in 'namespace ActivitySensor' while scenario pages in 'namespace SDKTemplate'; .uwp-source csproj has <RootNamespace>SDKTemplate</RootNamespace><AssemblyName>ActivitySensor</AssemblyName>.
items.skill_search: Grepped winui-uwp-migration for 'namespace', 'RootNamespace', 'SDKTemplate', 'CS0118', and the Step 0 scaffold instruction 'dotnet new winui -n <ProjectName>'.
items.root_cause: Step 0 tells the agent to scaffold with 'dotnet new winui -n <ProjectName>' but gives no rule to (a) set the project name / <RootNamespace> / scaffold shell-file namespaces to the UWP source's original <RootNamespace>, or (b) avoid a project name that equals a WinRT type the app references. Choosing the API-derived project name creates a root namespace that both mismatches the ported pages and shadows the like-named WinRT type. Neither SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, nor the bootstrap script reconciles the scaffold namespace with the source namespace, and PATTERNS.md's 'Common build errors' section documents CS0104/CS0227/CS0246 but not CS0118.
items.proposed_fix: 1) Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: after copying source, read <RootNamespace> from the preserved .uwp-source csproj and align the target csproj <RootNamespace> plus the scaffold-generated shell files (App/MainWindow x:Class, namespace, xmlns:local, using) to it, so the app has ONE root namespace equal to the source's — which also cannot collide with a WinRT type because SDK samples use SDKTemplate. 2) MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors': add a CS0118 entry (root cause + fix: single namespace = source RootNamespace, or fully-qualify the WinRT type). 3) SKILL.md Step 0: one-line rule to keep every file (scaffold + ported) in the source's root namespace and never rename to the project/API name.
items.generalizes: The Windows-universal-samples corpus (the primary UWP migration input) uniformly uses 'namespace SDKTemplate' for page code while naming each app after the API it demonstrates (Accelerometer, Barometer, Compass, Gyrometer, ProximitySensor, ActivitySensor, ...). Any agent that scaffolds with the API-derived project name reproduces exactly this scaffold-vs-ported namespace split and, whenever the project name equals a referenced WinRT type, the CS0118 shadowing failure. This is a recurring, build-blocking class of failure across the whole sample family, not a one-off.
